g.text: TIC-1020 / PIC-1021 H-101 COT -> FUEL GAS PRESSURE CASCADE
24 VDC loop powered from I/O card (2-wire)
24 VDC loop powered from I/O card (2-wire)
BMS: PIC-1021 forced to min / track on trip
1. TT-1020 (BPCS) is independent of the SIS transmitters TT-1020A/B/C (SIF-106); separate thermowells.
2. Cascade: TIC-1020 output + feed-forward (charge x dT, lead-lag) -> fuel demand -> low select with air available (cross-limiting) -> burner curve f(x) -> PIC-1021 SP. See CFU-100-IC-CSD-001.
3. PV-1021 fail-closed (FC) on air failure; min-fire mechanical stop not used (min-fire in DCS logic).
